tasks.title: Poll dispatches when work is dispatchable and nothing runs
tasks.goal: F23: a campaign can rest with dispatchable work because poll compares observation digests and declines to wake an unchanged world. Add the liveness arm: if the registration has dispatchable work (an unblocked, un-escalated task) and zero live nodes, poll admits a reconcile pass regardless of the observation digest. Cover both the unit surface and the VM poll assertions in flake.nix — the VM checks are exactly where this class of change historically broke eval (F21), so you own flake.nix up front.
deliveredBehaviors: A resting campaign with dispatchable work is woken by the next poll
An armed campaign with nothing dispatchable still rests (no busy-loop)

acceptanceCriteria.description: The dispatchable-work liveness path exists in poll.

tasks.title: Status renders the last reconciled truth, never a placeholder
tasks.goal: Shakedown finding: campaign status renders the LATEST pass — after a steer or re-arm that is a queued, un-reconciled pass, so the operator sees an empty task table, zero counts, and the placeholder name 'Campaign campaign' while real work runs under the previous pass. Fix: when the latest pass has not reconciled a task table, status falls back to the most recent reconciled pass (or the registration's durable task state) and labels the queued pass as queued; the campaign name always comes from the registration/worklist, never a placeholder. This deletes the operator rule 'do not trust status, use query run' (D58: fixes delete rules).
deliveredBehaviors: Status never renders an empty table while a previous pass has reconciled truth
The campaign name is never a placeholder
A queued un-reconciled pass is labeled as such
